title: Speaking — Making appointments
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on making appointments.

questions: What is a typical breakfast for you?
When do you usually eat your main meal?
Which meal of the day do you most look forward to?
Do you enjoy eating with several other people?
What kinds of appointments do you book online?
How do you remind yourself about an important appointment?

part2.topic: Describe a service that became easier for you to arrange.
part2.closing: and explain whether the service could still be improved.

questions: Which services should always offer a way to book by phone or in person?
Why do some businesses still struggle to make online booking easy?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to making appointments?
